description: This file defines a REST API for managing saved queries in the Superset application, including endpoints for bulk deletion, export, and import of saved queries, with associated database handling and file processing.

classes.name: SavedQueryRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class providing endpoints for managing saved queries, including bulk delete, export, and import functionalities, with route protections and schema validations.

methods.name: pre_add
methods.description: Assigns the current user to the saved query before adding.

methods.name: pre_update
methods.description: Prepares the saved query for update by reassigning the user.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Handles bulk deletion of saved queries via DELETE request.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports selected saved queries as a ZIP file containing YAML files.

methods.name: import_
methods.description: Imports saved queries from an uploaded ZIP file, handling associated database configurations.
